headline: Executive order titled "Preventing Woke AI in the Federal Government" sets policy on artificial intelligence used by federal agencies.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with the artificial intelligence (AI) tools that federal agencies use or buy. The title suggests it sets rules about political or social viewpoints in those AI systems. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements, deadlines, and enforcement steps are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies would likely have to follow new policy on which AI tools they use or buy.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that sell AI products to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: AI vendors may face new standards for products they sell to federal agencies.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 23, 2025; specific effective dates or deadlines were not provided.
